result.question: What does the man of God cry at Bethel?

readings.answer: A prophecy against the altar: that a son named Josiah of David’s house will sacrifice the high-place priests on it and burn human bones on it.
readings.support: O altar, O altar, this is what the LORD says: ‘A son named Josiah will be born to the house of David, and upon you he will sacrifice the priests of the high places who burn incense upon you, and human bones will be burned upon you.’

readings.answer: A confirming sign: that the altar will split and its ashes will be poured out.
readings.support: The LORD has spoken this sign: ‘Surely the altar will be split apart, and the ashes upon it will be poured out.’

assessments.reason: It quotes the utterance he cried against the altar, including that human bones will be burned on it, which matches the key’s focus.
This is the separate sign he gave (“gave a sign, saying”), not what he “cried” against the altar, and it does not mention burning bones.

result.reason: The passage states he cried that human bones would be burned on the altar, which directly matches the key.
